description: Hashes of every emitted method body, rendered symbolically, for every coverage row and for a fixed sequence of fuzz shapes at each lane and over both, at 128 and 512 bits (lanesOverride 4 and 16 at the int lane, 2 and 8 at the long one). A difference is a change in what an emitted method does. `option_arms` covers emissions beyond the defaults: one digest over every shape at each width per value of spark.sql.codegen.varka.emit.useAVX, the only emit option a configuration reaches, and per value of each option the defaults never reach, over the options under which it acts (validityOrFirst); and per reference form whose frames span the kernel (groupLocalSlots=false, methodByteBudget=0), which no session selects but where a per-body slot rule can move bytes unseen. The rest of VarkaEmitOptions is test-only.
